No machinery implemented; no compute; no sealed data.
NOT_AN_APPROVAL: SCIENTIFIC PROTOCOL for design RE-REVIEW only. NO approved execution record, NO launch packet, NO image digest, NO pipeline code change. Two-review gate: (1) this + the exposure inventory + the machine-derived exposure index are re-reviewed for FINAL design approval; (2) after approval the machinery is implemented + tested; (3) a SECOND review binds exact code sha, image digest, manifests and execution packets before any launch. Sealed evaluation, promotion and deployment remain HELD.
purpose: An UNSEALED, directional HELD-OUT DEVELOPMENT NOMINATION: compare KD candidate recipes against a matched KD-disabled control and the mechanics-proven anchor, to nominate at most one recipe to carry into a future full-Arm-2 training request. It is NOT a confirmation and touches no sealed data.

terminology.held_out_development_nomination: Phase A scores candidates on HELD-OUT DEVELOPMENT remainders. For english/french/swahili the base model has already been scored on these pools, so they are candidate-blind but NOT base-blind: this is NOMINATION, not confirmation.
terminology.confirmation: reserved for the base-blind Phase B on newly-acquired untouched data + the sealed holdout; HELD.

KD_CONTROL.role: matched control at identical budget/seed/data-order so preservation is attributable to KD versus base under-training

shared_wrapper_requirement: BOTH modes MUST run pipeline.omniasr_calibrate so both emit identical serving-readyz / parity / dev-WER / authoritative receipts (post-approval implementation).

comparators_not_nominable.kind: frozen base checkpoint (inference only on the nomination rows; seed-independent)

comparators_not_nominable.status: MECHANICS_PROVEN (has the completed 30-step mechanics/memory receipt ARM2-FTCAL-2026-001; that receipt proves MECHANICS only, not a comparator result)
comparators_not_nominable.note: COMPARATOR-ONLY anchor: H0 can never be the nominated winner; candidates must BEAT it

no_selection_stage: The 600-step diagnostic screen is REMOVED. All six training arms (KD_CONTROL, H0, H1-H4) are trained FRESH to 2000 steps under one matched seed + data order, then scored once on the frozen nomination rows. No config is dropped on a partial-step heuristic.

training.matched: identical MEDZEN_SEED AND identical data ordering across all six arms

second_seed.resolves_contradiction: H0 is the comparator every candidate must beat, so H0 MUST have both seeds for a balanced paired seed-pooled comparison; the second seed therefore re-runs the finalist AND H0 AND KD_CONTROL (base_teacher and arm1 are seed-independent fixed checkpoints)

evaluation.identical_rows_requirement: for every language, base_teacher, arm1, H0, KD_CONTROL and every candidate/finalist are scored on the SAME frozen rows, paired row-for-row
evaluation.exposure_index: platform/manifests/B5-UNIVERSAL-ARM2-EXPOSURE-INDEX-2026-001.json (machine-derived); the nomination split MUST pass its intersection test (audio_checksum_sha256 disjoint from used_union + every s3_pinned_pool + every sealed half)

phase_A_held_out_development_nomination_.outcome: nominates at most one candidate recipe (directional); confirms nothing for promotion

phase_B_base_blind_confirmation_HELD.requirement: a base-blind, never-scored, untouched confirmation set for lingala/kinyarwanda/ewe (and base-blind english/french/swahili) does NOT exist in-repo and requires NEW licensed/commissioned acquisition (pursued in PARALLEL per owner). The atomic 7-language blind promotion gate is BLOCKED on that acquisition and remains HELD. Part-2 alone can never promote.

preservation_objective.macro: unweighted mean WER over {english, french, swahili} on the seed-pooled nomination split; this is the SOLE macro used for beat-H0, beat-KD_CONTROL and the tie-break
preservation_objective.separated_from: pidgin retention is a SEPARATE gate (below), NOT folded into the preservation macro

pidgin_retention_objective.gate: a SEPARATE pass/fail non-inferiority-vs-Arm-1 constraint; pidgin is the only base+candidate-blind language, so it is the retention anchor but is scored and gated on its OWN objective, not averaged into preservation

preservation_non_inferiority.reference: the frozen base teacher's per-language WER on the SAME rows
preservation_non_inferiority.test: speaker cluster-bootstrap; PASS iff one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_base) <= +0.005 (0.5pp) per gated language, after multiplicity correction

pidgin_retention.reference: Arm-1's WER on the SAME pidgin rows (arm1 scored on the frozen split)
pidgin_retention.test: speaker cluster-bootstrap; PASS iff one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_arm1) <= +0.005 (0.5pp), after multiplicity correction

directional_development_vetoes.nature: HARD VETO, never a positive gate. These languages have NO untouched data (already-seen surfaces), so a good score CANNOT confirm preservation; but a GROSS regression is still disqualifying.
directional_development_vetoes.veto_rule: a candidate is VETOED (removed from nomination, even if it passes english/french/swahili/pidgin) iff, on the language's directional surface, the one-sided 95% LOWER bound of (WER_candidate - reference) > +0.02 (i.e. we are 95% confident it regressed by MORE than 2.0 absolute WER points). The 2.0pp floor is deliberately generous (seen data, so only gross breakage vetoes).
directional_development_vetoes.not_a_gate: passing the veto is NOT evidence of preservation for these languages; that requires Phase-B base-blind data.

constraints.kd_attribution: each candidate is compared DIRECTLY to the matched KD_CONTROL at identical budget/seed/data-order; a candidate must beat the control on the preservation macro to credit any gain to KD

statistics.metric: WER = sum(edit_distance) / sum(reference_words) per language, from per-row edit-distance receipts
statistics.clustering: SPEAKER-level cluster bootstrap: resample SPEAKERS with replacement, B >= 10000, paired (same resampled speaker set across compared arms). Pools with placeholder/single speaker ids (ewe soreva) fall back to utterance-level and are directional-veto-only regardless
statistics.seed_aggregation: the finalist + H0 + KD_CONTROL run under two matched seeds; a gated verdict PASSES only if it holds on the seed-POOLED cluster bootstrap AND under EACH seed individually (no seed reversal)
statistics.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the family = {4 candidates x (3 preservation langs + pidgin retention + 3 directional vetoes)} + the beat-KD_CONTROL and beat-H0 preservation-macro tests, family-wise alpha = 0.05

selection_rule.qualify: a CANDIDATE (H1-H4) QUALIFIES iff, on the Phase-A nomination split, after Holm-Bonferroni AND under both seeds: (a) preservation non-inferiority passes for english, french, swahili; AND (b) pidgin retention passes; AND (c) NO directional veto fires for lingala/kinyarwanda/ewe; AND (d) it beats the matched KD_CONTROL on the preservation macro (one-sided 95% lower bound of (WER_control - WER_candidate) > 0); AND (e) it beats the H0 mechanics-proven anchor on the preservation macro (one-sided 95% lower bound of (WER_H0 - WER_candidate) > 0)
selection_rule.tie_break: among qualifiers, DETERMINISTIC: (1) lowest preservation macro WER on the seed-pooled split; (2) ties -> lowest KD alpha; (3) ties -> lexicographically smallest recipe id
selection_rule.NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES: if NO candidate qualifies, the terminal outcome is NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES -> no Arm-2 recipe change is nominated (hold at H0), and a new design is predeclared; the protocol NEVER silently nominates the least-bad recipe
selection_rule.H0_is_comparator_only: H0 (mechanics-proven anchor) can never be the nominated winner; if no candidate beats H0 the outcome is NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES

nomination_data_rules.status: NOT YET MINTED — post-approval; see exposure inventory + the machine-derived exposure index
nomination_data_rules.phaseA_split_source: the per-language HELD-OUT DEVELOPMENT remainder for english/french/swahili/pidgin (pool minus the 60 selection rows minus the sealed half); pidgin (av-heldout remainder) is the only base+candidate-blind language
rules: DISJOINT by audio_checksum_sha256 from the machine-derived exposure index used_union AND every s3_pinned_pool AND every sealed half (proven by the index intersection test at mint)
PREDECLARED + committed + FROZEN (per-row audio_checksum_sha256 + per-pool S3 version_id/etag/KMS) BEFORE any arm is scored
opened ONCE per seed: all arms + comparators scored in a single pass; no iterative re-fitting
the sealed promotion holdout is NEVER touched

cost_runtime_table.instance: ml.g6.xlarge on-demand (never spot); padded rate $1.60/h; measured 30-step calibration = 1228 billable s (fixed overhead ~1073 s + ~5.18 s/step)
cost_runtime_table.scoring_throughput_basis: the flat one-hour scoring assumption is REPLACED. Scoring caps are sized to a CONSERVATIVE inference-throughput FLOOR of ~2 utterances/sec for omniASR CTC 1B on ml.g6.xlarge across ~3,234 nomination+directional rows/model. A MANDATORY predeclared micro-benchmark (a small scoring probe) MEASURES actual throughput and the scoring caps are FINALIZED from it at the second review before any scoring job runs.

jobs.job: 3 second-seed runs (finalist + H0 + KD_CONTROL @ 2000 steps, seed 2)
seed-1 scoring pass (8 models x ~3,234 rows, ~2 utt/s floor)
seed-2 scoring pass (3 models x ~3,234 rows)

cost_runtime_table.note: base_teacher and arm1 are existing checkpoints scored within the scoring passes (no training job).

budget.reservation: serial (one job reserved at a time)
budget.automatic_retries: NONE — any retry requires separate owner authorization
budget.per_job_runtime: hard MaxRuntimeInSeconds per job (table above), finalized from the measured-throughput benchmark at second review
budget.reporting_rule: on-demand always; +$100 on every reported max => reported max <= $170

two_review_gate.first_review: THIS design + the exposure inventory + the machine-derived exposure index (PENDING_DESIGN_REVIEW); no code, no packets, no launch
two_review_gate.second_review: AFTER implementation + tests + the measured-throughput benchmark: bind the exact code sha, trainer image digest, nomination manifest, and per-recipe execution packets BEFORE any launch

holds: hyperparameter SELECTION output, sealed evaluation, promotion, deployment ALL remain HELD. The base-blind 7-language confirmation gate (Phase B) is a data-acquisition prerequisite, held (pursued in parallel). This protocol authorizes NOTHING to run.
